data.content_ref: inline:Encode support edges as bounded-depth generated auxiliary arguments rather than as primitive relations. For a support edge y => x, generate a bounded chain of auxiliary nodes z_0..z_k such that z_0 is attacked by every attacker of x, each z_i attacks all attackers of x, and z_i is supported by y; translate the support into standard attack edges. With k fixed, the graph grows by O(k*E) and the grounded extension remains deterministic and polynomial. This gives support a causal, Dung-native mechanism while keeping reinstatement a derived property of the same fixpoint, and auxiliary nodes are not committed roots, so no root validity is altered.
